about_pullquote: We treat your home's plumbing like it's our own — honest pricing, no panic surcharges.
about_para_1: CXG Plumbing & Heating has been serving Guildford homes and businesses for 18 years. We started because we saw too many neighbours overcharged by cowboys on emergency calls. From day one, we've focused on fair pricing, rapid response, and work that lasts. Today we've completed over 2,400 jobs and trained a team of Gas Safe registered engineers we're genuinely proud of.
about_para_2: Homeowners trust us because we show up when we say we will, diagnose problems honestly, and never charge call-out fees. Our repeat customer rate is 67% — the best compliment we can get. Whether it's 3am on a Sunday or a routine boiler service, we treat the job with the same care and attention.
reviews_heading: What Guildford Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare burst pipe flooding the kitchen on Christmas Eve. Called CXG and someone was at the door within 45 minutes. Fixed it properly, tidied up after themselves, and didn't overcharge me on a callout. Brilliant service. Will 100% use them again.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Been with CXG for my boiler servicing for the last 5 years. Always professional, always on time, and they actually explain what they're doing instead of just taking your money. Renewed our whole heating system last year — excellent job and the warranty gives real peace of mind.
reviews.author: Jennifer K.

reviews.text: Found them online after our radiator started leaking at 11pm on a Sunday. I honestly thought we'd be quoted the earth for an emergency job. Not only did they come out same evening, but the price was fair and the lad was friendly and helpful. Top marks.
reviews.author: Paul T.
